notes.title: Unable to save the game?
notes.content:
Hello everyone, in order to make the game run more smoothly, I switched the game framework from Nw.js to Webview2 in the latest version. But this also caused some players to be unable to save the game.

Generally speaking, this is because the version of Webview2 in the system is too low, causing the game to be unable to recognize your Steam game folder. You can solve the problem by downloading and updating Webview2 on the Microsoft official website.

Update address: https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/?form=MA13LH

notes.title: CozySudoku 1.4.0 - Stamp Fill Mode
notes.content:
- Fixed the bug where undo caused pencil marks to appear in cells 
- Enhanced number outlines for identical numbers to make them more prominent 
- Added a new feature: "Stamp Fill." In stamp mode, you can select a number first and then a cell to fill it. The shortcut for stamp mode is the S key
- Modified storage format to fix save parsing issues

notes.title: Support keyboard input
notes.content:
Support keyboard input:

[list]
[*] 1~9 Keys - Fill in numbers in the current grid
[*] N Key - Active/Disable Note
[*] Back Key - Undo
[*] Del Key - Clear Number
[/list]
